rationale: Tests ARIA classification (intermittent vs persistent, mild vs moderate-severe) — the key diagnostic framework taught in this block

Tests a core PE known-trap: intranasal corticosteroids (INCS) are the most effective pharmacological treatment for persistent allergic rhinitis — a fact students often underestimate in favour of antihistamines
Tests GINA-based severity classification and appropriate first-line controller selection — core to developing a treatment plan as required by PE28.3
Tests the PE/GINA known-trap that LABA must never be used as monotherapy in children with asthma — a patient-safety-critical rule
